title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Foreign Political Donations) Bill 2016
short_title: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Foreign Political Donations) Bill 2016

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would make it illegal for Australian political parties and candidates to accept money from overseas donors.
It would add a new rule to the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 banning donations from anyone defined as a 'foreign person' under the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act 1975.
Donations under $1,000 would be exempt, and a party or candidate that receives a banned donation would have 30 days to return it.
changes: Bans donations from foreign sources to Australian political parties and candidates.
Requires repayment of prohibited donations within 30 days.
summary.affected: Australian political parties, candidates, and foreign donors.

speeches.speaker: Rebekha Sharkie
speeches.brief: The speaker requested to postpone the presentation of the Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Foreign Political Donations) Bill 2016 due to the member for Denison's weather-related delay.
